notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
- Updated intro branding
- Removed CRT effect (causing people headaches, oof)
- Player no longer rotates towards the cursor, since he is a cube...

notes.title: Tweaks, Tweaks & more Tweaks!
notes.content:
A lil'less sauce
- Removed Screen shake when collecting tokens.

Balancing
- Adjusted all enemy Health (more!)
- Reduced max rank of damage perk to 25, was 50
- Reduced max rank of health perk to 1, was 3
- Increased damage from turret to 110, was 30
- Reduced max rank of Enemy Explode perk to 10, was 13
- Reduced max rank of Bullet Count perk to 7, was 12

Good luck!

notes.title: Some more Lil'Fixes
notes.content:
Bug fixes

- Steam Achievements should now work correctly. (hopefully)
- Fixed timer displaying time from previous run for a couple of seconds when loading a new map.

notes.title: A Lil'Balance
notes.content:
Enemies:
Updated all enemies to gain less health overtime, max health not changed, just takes longer for them to get there.

- Basic enemies gain less health overtime.
- Mini Bosses gain less health overtime.
- Range enemies gain less health overtime.

- Slightly increased starting spawn amounts & reduced spawn overtime. Enemies should no longer spawn in such a large cluster at 1 minute mark.

Perks:
- Bonus Damage Perk: 
	- Increases damage by 42 down from 45.
	- 20 Max Ranks up from 8.

- Bullet Count Perk:
	- Costs 1450 to upgrade, up from 1020

- Updated info for Bonus Projectile Range perk
